issues.detail: The Hebrew lists 'Yeshua, Bani, Kadmiel, Shebaniah, Bunni, Sherebiah, Bani, Kenani' (8 names). The Vietnamese renders 'Giê-sua, Ba-ni, Ca-đơ-mi-ên, Sê-ba-nia, Bun-ni, Sê-rê-bia, Ba-ni và Kên-ni' — it drops the first 'Bani' (בָּנִי) and adds a second 'Ba-ni' later, so the name sequence is wrong: it omits the second Bani and inserts an extra Bani in its place, resulting in the same count but a different name order/identity.
